description: This file is a CMake script (.cmake) used for monitoring and tracking the state of a git repository during the build process. It defines macros and functions to retrieve git information, detect changes, and trigger reconfiguration when the repository state changes.

methods.name: GetGitState
methods.description: Retrieves current git repository state including commit hash, author, date, and status.

methods.name: HashGitState
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash of current git state variables to detect changes.

methods.name: CheckGit
methods.description: Checks whether the git repository has changed by comparing current state hash with stored hash.

methods.name: SetupGitMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up custom CMake build targets to monitor git state at build time.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main function executing the appropriate logic depending on whether it's configure or build time.
